name: stormbook-engine
description: Speed-to-lead conversion engine for storm-restoration roofing contractors.

scripts.preinstall: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');try{const g=execSync('npm ls -g --depth=0 --json',{stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']}).toString();const d=JSON.parse(g).dependencies||{};const bad=['wrangler','typescript'].filter(p=>d[p]);if(bad.length){console.error('Global install detected: '+bad.join(', ')+'. This project requires zero global installs. Uninstall with: npm uninstall -g '+bad.join(' '));process.exit(1)}}catch(e){}"
